statement: Operational control approach; global; includes owned, leased and co-located AWS data center electricity (Scope 2), delivery-network and fulfillment buildings, physical stores, Whole Foods Market

Scope 3 lists: last-mile delivery fleet, Amazon-operated and purchased freight, packaging, Amazon-branded product manufacturing, capital goods, commuting, customer trips to Amazon stores, use and end-of-life of Amazon devices. Resale merchandise and third-party seller products are not in the list
Reports market-based Scope 2; Scope 1 and 3 net of environmental attribute certificates (SAF, renewable diesel certificates; 199.4K t net impact in 2025)
Carbon intensity is TOTAL footprint (Scope 1+2+3) per $ revenue (changed from per $ gross merchandise sales); 112.8 g/$ in 2025
Walmart Inc. and consolidated subsidiaries, excluding acquired eCommerce subsidiaries, businesses, platforms or marketplaces unless noted; global; calendar-year emissions, fiscal-year revenue

Scope 1 includes the Walmart private truck fleet (transport fuel and mobile refrigerants = 24.9% of Scope 1) plus onsite refrigerants and stationary fuels; a retailer-with-own-fleet profile, like Amazon's delivery fleet but no AWS

Scope 3 is a broad order-of-magnitude estimate from category sales and emission factors; categories 1, 2, 11, 12 cover >95%; Cat 11 counts lifetime emissions of products sold; not comparable with Amazon Scope 3
Renewable share is incl. grid contribution (48.5%) and excl. grid (30.6%); Amazon claims 100% matched by purchases
Scope 1+2 for domestic (US) operations under operational control (Climate Registry protocol); international offices added in 2024; 2017 base year; fiscal year
